ambiguity.detail: The flash-forward introduces a banishment whose context is not yet fully explained.

verdict.hook_line: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!
verdict.cliffhanger_line: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A defiant bride gets dragged away by guards until a mysterious stranger steps up to defend her.
verdict.why_it_works: The cold-open flash-forward grabs attention instantly before dropping straight into the heart-wrenching rescue scene.
